3.name: Margin Long SOL
3.rationale: User deposits cSOL (KYC wrapper around wSOL), borrows plain sUSDC (the USD-side reuses the existing EG-1 reserve — no second wrap needed; gate flows through cSOL wrap-time whitelist). Conservative 65/85 reflects negative SOL/USD correlation — much wider liquidation buffer than EG-1/EG-2's 90/92 because no asset-pair correlation hedges the position.

4._status: design locked, deploy pending — see docs/operations/MARGIN_PAIR.md
4.name: Margin Short SOL
4.rationale: Mirror of EG-3. User deposits sUSDC, borrows cSOL → unwraps to wSOL (KYC-required) → swaps wSOL → sUSDC → re-deposits for layered short exposure. Non-KYC wallets can technically deposit sUSDC and borrow cSOL but cannot unwrap, so the position is economically inert — the wrap/unwrap requirement is the de-facto gate.
